summary: Measured order-level first/full fill waits, queue rank and remaining units ahead directly from accepted orders and actual trade IDs. Added a persistent-depth hold-versus-rejoin comparison across 32 paired synthetic seeds, a 1630-child lifecycle CSV and studio queue replay. Holding completes 253/256 parents versus 54/256 for re-entry; paired filled-quantity difference is -2.796875 units with 95% interval [-3.005687, -2.588063]. Cancellation and deadline-open outcomes remain distinct, with no independent fill-probability shortcut in this analysis.
